package hybridreplan

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"log/slog"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/repository"
)

// EvaluationProcessor has no Student application port. It persists a semantic
// consequence; applying that consequence belongs to the later owner boundary.
type EvaluationProcessor struct {
	Consequences repository.HybridConsequences
	Policies     repository.PolicyRepository
	Graphs       repository.GoalGraphRepository
	Clock        Clock
	LeaseTTL     time.Duration
	RetryDelay   time.Duration
}

func (p EvaluationProcessor) ProcessNext(ctx context.Context) (bool, error) {
	if p.Consequences == nil || p.Policies == nil || p.Graphs == nil || p.Clock == nil || p.LeaseTTL <= 0 || p.RetryDelay <= 0 {
		return false, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	work, claimed, err := p.Consequences.ClaimHybridConsequenceEvaluation(ctx, p.Clock.Now().UTC(), p.LeaseTTL)
	if err != nil || !claimed {
		return false, err
	}
	fail := func(cause error) (bool, error) {
		return true, errors.Join(cause, p.Consequences.ReleaseHybridConsequenceEvaluation(ctx, work, p.Clock.Now().UTC().Add(p.RetryDelay)))
	}
	remaining := work.LeaseUntil.Sub(p.Clock.Now().UTC())
	if remaining <= 0 {
		return fail(domain.ErrConflict)
	}
	if remaining > p.LeaseTTL {
		return fail(domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	workContext, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, remaining)
	defer cancel()
	leaseValid := func() error {
		if err := workContext.Err(); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if !work.LeaseUntil.After(p.Clock.Now().UTC()) {
			return domain.ErrConflict
		}
		return nil
	}
	job := work.Job
	request := domain.HybridSnapshotRequest{Targets: job.Snapshot.RequestedTargets, TriggerContext: job.Snapshot.TriggerContext}
	if strings.TrimSpace(job.ID) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(work.ClaimToken) == "" || job.PolicyVersion != domain.HybridReplanPolicyVersion || job.SnapshotRef != job.Snapshot.References.SnapshotRef || domain.ValidateHybridPlanningSnapshot(job.Snapshot, job.StudentID, job.LearningPathID, request) != nil {
		return fail(domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	if err := leaseValid(); err != nil {
		return fail(err)
	}
	if work.Inputs == nil {
		policy, err := p.Policies.GetActivePolicyBundle(workContext)
		if err != nil {
			return fail(err)
		}
		if err := leaseValid(); err != nil {
			return fail(err)
		}
		graph, err := p.Graphs.GetPublishedGoalGraph(workContext, job.Snapshot.Path.GoalCode)
		var projection domain.HybridPrerequisiteGraph
		if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
			projection = domain.HybridPrerequisiteGraph{GoalCode: job.Snapshot.Path.GoalCode, Targets: []domain.HybridPrerequisiteTarget{}}
		} else if err != nil {
			return fail(err)
		} else {
			projection, err = domain.ProjectHybridPrerequisiteGraph(graph)
			if err != nil {
				return fail(err)
			}
			if projection.GoalCode != job.Snapshot.Path.GoalCode {
				return fail(domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid)
			}
		}
		if err := leaseValid(); err != nil {
			return fail(err)
		}
		pinned, err := p.Consequences.CheckpointHybridConsequenceInputs(workContext, work, policy, projection)
		if err != nil {
			return fail(err)
		}
		if pinned.Job.ID != job.ID || pinned.ClaimToken != work.ClaimToken || pinned.Inputs == nil {
			return fail(domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid)
		}
		// The repository returns durable first-observation pins; do not evaluate
		// against the temporary policy or graph values read above.
		work.Inputs = pinned.Inputs
	}
	if err := leaseValid(); err != nil {
		return fail(err)
	}
	consequence, err := domain.EvaluateHybridSnapshot(job.Snapshot, *work.Inputs)
	if err != nil {
		return fail(err)
	}
	if err := leaseValid(); err != nil {
		return fail(err)
	}
	if _, err := p.Consequences.CompleteHybridConsequenceEvaluation(workContext, work, consequence); err != nil {
		return fail(err)
	}
	return true, nil
}

type EvaluationWorker struct {
	Processor    EvaluationProcessor
	PollInterval time.Duration
	Logger       *slog.Logger
}

func (w EvaluationWorker) Run(ctx context.Context) {
	interval := w.PollInterval
	if interval <= 0 {
		interval = time.Second
	}
	logger := w.Logger
	if logger == nil {
		logger = slog.Default()
	}
	ticker := time.NewTicker(interval)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	for ctx.Err() == nil {
		processed, err := w.Processor.ProcessNext(ctx)
		if err != nil {
			logger.ErrorContext(ctx, "hybrid planning consequence evaluation failed", "error", err)
		}
		if processed && err == nil {
			continue
		}
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return
		case <-ticker.C:
		}
	}
}
